'''Tunda Ress''' was a [[humanoid]] [[Tunda Ress' species|species]] individual who was present in [[Jedha City]] on the<ref name="Rogue One" /> [[Mid Rim Territories]]<ref name="ROVG">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref> [[moon]] [[Jedha]] shortly before the [[Galactic Empire]] [[Destruction of Jedha City|destroyed]] the [[city]] in order to test the capabilities of their [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]]<ref name="Rogue One" /> in [[1 BBY]].<ref name="Year">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' to [[1 BBY]].</ref> Ress and an individual in similar attire passed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] [[intelligence officer]] [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] and his companion [[Jyn Erso]] in the city, narrowly avoiding bumping into them.<ref name="Rogue One" /> They wore a mask made out of [[Chromium|chrome]], [[Color|brown]]-and-grey [[robe]]s, and carried a [[DH-17 blaster pistol|DH-17]] [[blaster]] [[Blaster pistol|pistol]].<ref name="Chrome Faces">{{SWCT|set=Rogue One - Shadow Portraits|cardname=Chrome Faces}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Tunda Ress first appeared in the [[2016]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology]] film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="Rogue One" /> Scenes including Ress were filmed in [[Wikipedia:Jordan|Jordan]] between [[July 23]]–[[July 24|24]], [[2015]].<ref name="SBtA">''[[Star Wars: Stormtroopers: Beyond the Armor]]''</ref> The accompanying book ''[[The Art of Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''<ref name="Art">''[[The Art of Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> features a character concept labeled "Jedha Alien G0021," drawn by [[Adam Brockbank]], although it is unclear whether it depicts Ress or their identical companion. In the concept, Ress' face was drawn in an organic manner<ref name="Art" /> instead of the [[metal]]lic face mask featured in the film.<ref name="Rogue One" />

In a [[2018]] card for [[Topps]]' [[Star Wars: Card Trader|''Star Wars'': Card Trader]] mobile application, titled "Chrome Faces – Rogue One – Shadow Portraits," Ress is referred to as a "Chrome Face."<ref name="Chrome Faces" /> The character received a name in [[2019]] with the release of the card "Marathon 2019 – Topps Choice – Tunda Ress."<ref name="Topps Choice">{{SWCT|set=Topps Choice|cardname=Tunda Ress}}</ref> A character wearing Tunda Ress' outfit appears in "[[Chapter 1: The Mandalorian]]," the first episode of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'',<ref name="Chapter 1">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 1: The Mandalorian}}</ref> which released on [[November 12]], [[2019]].<ref name="MandDate">{{InsiderCite|201|Star Wars: The Mandalorian Season One Companion|''Star Wars: The Mandalorian'' Season One Companion}}</ref> In downloadable content for [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Outlaws]]''{{'s}} ''Wild Card'' expansion,<ref name="Outlaws">''[[Star Wars Outlaws]]''</ref> released on [[November 21]], [[2024]],<ref name="DLCDate">{{Ubisoft|subdomain=store|url=us/star-wars-outlaws---cartel-ronin-bundle/66aa65c6046cab4bfdeab1c0.html|text=Star Wars Outlaws - Cartel Ronin Bundle|date=2024-11-21}}</ref> the [[gambler]] [[Rauvin Vashiri]] wears the same type of mask as Ress. Though she is established to be a [[human]], her mask is identified as a [[Mazanti face covering]].<ref name="Outlaws" />
